resources.string: Real output sizes reported for this lens and format. Current source: %1$d × %2$d. With 2× enabled, Auto prefers an advertised binned stream such as 4000 × 3000 (output 8000 × 6000). Manual sizes remain available. Aspect ratio crops the saved image.

For new photos: double width and height after rendering, retaining the selected colour engine. Uses RAISR detail with a Lanczos colour base; this is interpolation, not extra sensor resolution. Existing 2× RAW/JPGmax enlargement is retained. Fractional enlargement conflicts must be changed to 1× or 2×. HDR/gainmap export is unsupported for this finish pass. Export fails if there is insufficient memory; the original remains available.
2× upscale needs more memory than this output can safely use. The photo is exported at native resolution.
This source is already too large for the bitmap-based 2× finish stage. Native-resolution photos remain available; select a smaller source to enable 2×.
Full-sensor 2× output is written as tiled RAISR JPEG. It may take longer and needs free storage, but does not allocate a full-size output bitmap.
2× processing could not finish. The photo was saved at native resolution instead.
Photo finish upscale failed. The original photo is still available.
2× native grid: %1$d × %2$d · %3$.1f MP, before crop or frame.
2× finish upscale does not support HDR/gainmap export. The original photo is retained.
2× finish upscale conflicts with fractional RAW/JPGmax enlargement. Use 1× or 2× capture scaling for new photos. The original photo is retained.
